tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search live cybersecurity jobs from 200+ security companies (updated hourly). Returns up to 10 matching roles plus the total match count and a browse URL for the full list. All Apply flows go through the returned job URLs.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get one job by id: role details, a short description excerpt, and the canonical job-page URL (which is also where to apply).

tools.name: salary_benchmark
tools.description: Curated cybersecurity salary benchmark bands (USD + local currency) across 21 countries including the US, EU, Gulf (tax-free), India, LatAm, and Africa.

tools.name: market_stats
tools.description: Live aggregate cybersecurity hiring stats: total open security roles, new this week, remote share, salary-disclosure rate, and top specializations / seniorities / countries.

tools.name: top_employers
tools.description: The security companies with the most open cybersecurity roles right now (objective open-roles ranking with remote share and pay-transparency rate).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_job · Public sink: market_stats, top_employers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_job · Public sink: market_stats, top_employers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
